It serves as a hyperbolic way to express secondhand embarrassment or lighthearted disapproval.

definition: It's really cool. Used to refer to something really cool good or amazing.

definition: In slang drop has several meanings depending on the context. Can release something if it's used in the world of music games fashion or social media; send/share something if it's followed by a link file or information; leave/come somewhere; fall; even drop if it concerns price/level.

definition: Excessive in action. Used to describe someone who is too excited.

definition: Theft of food between friends.

definition: In the context of social media filters are visual effects that are used to change the appearance of a photo or video for example beautifying a face adding color or giving a funny effect.

definition: Short for I am going to or I am about to.

definition: This means that it is really cool extraordinary or very top-notch. It is usually used for music fashion food or anything that is considered very good.

definition: In slang flex means to show off something usually in the form of expensive items achievements or lifestyles. It can be neutral (just showy) or negative (arrogant).

definition: More specifically than flex flex on means showing off something with the aim of showing off in front of others.

definition: Short-term or temporary jobs. Originally the term was popular in the music world (for band performances) but now it's often used for freelance or side jobs.
origin_context: Example: She got a gig as a freelance designer. (He got a job as a freelance designer.)

definition: To hype praise or compliment someone so much that it becomes annoying or excessive.
origin_context: The term glaze originated from the idea of glazing someone with excessive praise essentially coating them in compliments until it becomes embarrassing or sycophantic. It is primarily used in internet culture to describe someone who is acting like a fanboy or obsessively defending another person.

definition: Shining or looking attractive it is usually used to compliment someone's appearance that looks fresh or happy.
origin_context: Example sentence: You're glowing today! (You look so shining today!)

definition: Slang for positive transformation usually in terms of one's appearance confidence or lifestyle.
origin_context: Example sentence: She had a major glow up since high school. (She's turned completely into a cooler person since high school.)

definition: The opposite of glow up glow-down means a negative change in a person from before.

definition: Acronym for greatest of all time.
origin_context: The term GOAT originated in the 1990s notably popularized by boxing legend Muhammad Ali who referred to himself as the greatest. It is now widely used in sports music and pop culture to identify someone or something as the undisputed best in their field.

definition: An AAVE phrase and slang term meaning goofy ass used to label content as goofy or silly.
origin_context: Goofy ahh originated from text-to-speech mispronunciations of goofy ass in viral TikTok memes where the filter would replace the ss sound with ah. It is now widely used on social media to mock or describe content that is perceived as absurd silly or awkward.

definition: Grands is slang for calling grandmother and grandfather aka grandparents in a short and familiar way.
origin_context: Example sentence: I'm going to visit Grands. (I want to visit my grandparents.)

definition: Behaviors or personality traits that are considered positive healthy or desirable.
origin_context: Originating from the metaphor of a green traffic light signaling that it is safe to proceed the term is used in dating and social contexts to identify healthy positive traits in a person. It serves as the direct opposite of a red flag indicating that someone is a safe or desirable partner or friend.

definition: Constant hard work to achieve a goal be it work school or personal endeavor.

definition: In slang grub means food. Used in a casual or casual tone usually when inviting a meal together.

definition: On social media hashtags (hashtags #) are used to tag specific categories or topics to make posts easy to find.
origin_context: Example sentence: Don't forget to use hashtags to get more views. (Don't forget to wear hashtag to get more views.)

definition: Slang for something very obvious real or overt. The opposite of low-key which means secretly.
origin_context: Example sentence: I high-key want that new phone. (I really want the new phone.)

definition: Hot girl summer is a phrase that encourages women to embrace confidence self-acceptance and living life to the fullest during the summer months. It promotes a carefree empowered and unapologetic attitude.
origin_context: Hot girl summer originated from a 2019 tweet by rapper Megan Thee Stallion who defined it as a period for women to be unapologetically themselves and have fun. The term quickly went viral evolving into a cultural movement focused on confidence self-love and living life to the fullest.

definition: Slang for someone or a messy situation but there's still a funny or interesting side to it.
origin_context: Example sentence: I'm a hot mess during finals week. (I was really screwed up during the week of the final exam.)

definition: Working hard with a lot of effort is often used to motivate or describe how hard a person works to achieve a goal.
origin_context: Example sentence: Gotta hustle if you want to hit that deadline. (You'll have to work hard if you want to catch up on that deadline.)

definition: Hype is used to describe something that is exciting crowded or high in enthusiasm. It can be for events trends or atmospheres.
origin_context: Example sentence: The party last night was hype! (Last night's party was very crowded and exciting!)

definition: It is used to refer to someone who really likes trendy items especially fashion and often buys branded products for style.
origin_context: Example sentence: He's such a hypebeast with those shoes. (He's a very hypebeast with those shoes.)

definition: Used to express shock embarrassment and/or amusement.
origin_context: I oop originated from a 2019 viral video by drag queen Jasmine Masters where she accidentally interrupted herself mid-sentence after hitting her chair. It is now commonly used in digital spaces to express a sudden realization faux pas or unexpected reaction to a messy situation.

definition: Saying I'm baby is a way of acknowledging one's inexperience naivety or lack of knowledge about a particular situation or topic. It's a self-deprecating admission of being a beginner or novice.
origin_context: I'm baby originated from internet memes depicting cute helpless animals and it is used to playfully claim innocence or a need for coddling when one feels overwhelmed or lacks experience. It serves as a lighthearted way to deflect responsibility or ask for gentle treatment by positioning oneself as small and vulnerable.

definition: A sudden feeling of disgust or repulsion for something one was previously attracted to.
origin_context: The term gained widespread popularity on TikTok and social media following its use in the 1997 television series *Ally McBeal* to describe a sudden irrevocable loss of romantic interest. Today it is used to describe a specific minor action or quirk that makes someone instantly unappealing.
